messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Hindi, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Hindi line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
पर तुम, इतनी बड़ी नीरसता में क्यों लौटते हो? तो तुम वह मनोरम पर्वत क्यों नहीं चढ़ते? जो सभी आनंद का मूल और कारण है?

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Ma | Conjunction, adversative | पर | but | OK | | tu | Personal pronoun, 2nd sg | तुम | you | OK | | perché | Interrogative adverb (seeks cause) | क्यों | why | OK | | ritorni | Verb, 2nd sg present “return” | लौटते हो | (you) return | OK | | a | Preposition “to / in” | में | in | OK | | tanta | Adjective intensifier “so great” | इतनी बड़ी | so great | OK | | noia | Noun “annoyance / boredom” | नीरसता | boredom / annoyance | OK | | perché | Interrogative adverb (seeks cause) | क्यों | why | OK | | non | Negative particle | नहीं | not | OK | | sali | Verb “ascend / climb” | चढ़ते | ascend | **GRAMMAR** (missing auxiliary *हो* for 2nd sg) | | il | Definite article (masc. sg.) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** (Hindi omits articles) | | dilettoso | Adjective “delightful” | मनोरम | delightful | OK | | monte | Noun “mountain” | पर्वत | mountain | OK | | ch'è | Relative pronoun + copula “which is” | जो | which | OK | | principio | Noun “source / origin” | मूल | source / origin | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | और | and | OK | | cagion | Noun “cause” | कारण | cause | OK | | di | Preposition “of” (genitive) | का | of | OK | | tutta | Quantifier “all / every” | सभी | all / every | OK | | gioia | Noun “joy” | आनंद | joy | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **sali → चढ़ते** – *GRAMMAR*: the Hindi clause lacks the auxiliary **हो** required for correct 2nd‑person singular agreement (“चढ़ते हो”). - **il** – *UNNECESSARY*: Hindi does not use definite articles; the word is omitted in the translation.
*(No other source words are missing or incorrectly rendered.)*

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Hindi script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Hindi text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 76:** - Original: पर तुम, इतनी बड़ी नीरसता में क्यों लौटते हो? - Issue: none - Corrected: पर तुम, इतनी बड़ी नीरसता में क्यों लौटते हो?
- **Line 77:** - Original: तो तुम वह मनोरम पर्वत क्यों नहीं चढ़ते? - Issue: **GRAMMAR** – missing auxiliary *हो*; **UNNECESSARY** – discourse particle *तो* not present in source. - Corrected: तुम वह मनोरम पर्वत क्यों नहीं चढ़ते हो?
- **Line 78:** - Original: जो सभी आनंद का मूल और कारण है? - Issue: none - Corrected: जो सभी आनंद का मूल और कारण है?
